mentions.name: Joel Embiid
mentions.analysis: Embiid's status is uncertain, and with a two-game week for Philly, it's advised to bench him unless there's excellent news about his availability.

mentions.name: LaMelo Ball
mentions.analysis: Despite being questionable, LaMelo is expected to play through his issues, and with a three-game week, he should be started.

mentions.name: Paul George
mentions.analysis: No positive updates on Paul George, so he should be benched.

mentions.name: Dejounte Murray
mentions.analysis: Out for four to six weeks after hand surgery, making him an obvious bench.

mentions.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
mentions.analysis: Upgraded to questionable and with a favorable schedule, Jaren Jackson Jr. should be started.

mentions.name: Ja Morant
mentions.analysis: Despite being downgraded to questionable, Ja Morant should be started due to the favorable schedule.

mentions.name: Immanuel Quickley
mentions.analysis: Ruled out for the back-to-back, and it's uncertain if he'll play enough games next week to warrant starting.

mentions.name: Bradley Beal
mentions.analysis: Questionable for the weekend game, but with a three-game week, he should be started if he plays.

mentions.name: Brandon Miller
mentions.analysis: Due to a strained glute and uncertain return, he should be benched.

mentions.name: Bogdan Bogdanovic
mentions.analysis: Ruled out with hamstring tendinopathy, but if he plays on Sunday, he could be a good option for a four-game week.

mentions.name: Mark Williams
mentions.analysis: Ruled out with no positive updates, so he should be benched.

mentions.name: Chris Middleton
mentions.analysis: Still out, so he should be benched.

mentions.name: RJ Barrett
mentions.analysis: Upgraded to questionable, and if he plays on Saturday, he should be started next week.

mentions.name: Andre Drummond
mentions.analysis: With a two-game week, Drummond is not worth starting unless Embiid is out longer.

mentions.name: Kelly Oubre Jr.
mentions.analysis: Despite the two-game week, Oubre has the potential to explode and should be considered for starting.

mentions.name: Tyrese Maxey
mentions.analysis: The only definite start from Philly due to his consistent performance.
